notes.title: SoundKilla Beta v1.2
notes.content: This update includes new UI re-design changes, Front flip animation, graphical improvements and the introduction of destructible environments adding three new buildings to destroy. New team death match mode enabled. More updates to come! thanks to all that have been playing. Respect one love!

notes.title: Patch v.1.1
notes.content: SoundKilla Betav1.1 includes more optimization and attempts to introduce steam multiplayer. This is a work in progress please provide feedback for encountered issues or bugs. Includes steam overlay and host game session.

notes.title: Patch notes for Soundkilla beta v 1.0
